# Preliminary

```{r}
#| label: library-import
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  

library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(kableExtra)
library(stats)
library(broom)

gum <- read_csv("gumR2026.csv") |> 
  mutate(trtgroup = trtgroup |> 
           factor() |> 
           relevel(ref = "Placebo"))

```

# Treatment effects, part 1

```{r}
#| label: 1a
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  
#| tbl-cap: "Main Effect Model: The effect of treatment group on three month mutans streptococci (MS) levels"
#| tbl-cap-location: top


gum_q1 <- gum |> 
  filter(trtgroup != "NoGum")

model_1a <-  glm(
  mut3mos ~ trtgroup,
  family = gaussian(link = "identity"),
  data = gum_q1
)

summary(model_1a)

kable(tidy(model_1a, conf.int = TRUE), digits = 3)

```

```{r}
#| label: 1b
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  
#| tbl-cap: "Main Effect Model: The effect of treatment group and baseline MS levels on three month MS levels"
#| tbl-cap-location: top


model_1b <-  glm(
  mut3mos ~ mutpre + trtgroup,
  family = gaussian(link = "identity"),
  data = gum_q1
)

tidy(model_1b, conf.int = TRUE)


kable(tidy(model_1b, conf.int = TRUE), digits = 3)

```

## Interaction Model
```{r}
#| label: 1c-3
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  
#| tbl-cap: "Interaction Effect Model: The effect of treatment group and baseline MS levels on three month MS levels"
#| tbl-cap-location: top

model_1c <-  glm(
  mut3mos ~ trtgroup * mutpre,
  family = gaussian(link = "identity"),
  data = gum_q1
)

tidy(model_1c, conf.int = TRUE)


kable(tidy(model_1c, conf.int = TRUE), digits = 3)

```

## Participant with a Baseline MS level of 5.43
```{r}
#| label: 1c-iv
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  

library(doBy)

participant_1 <- c(0, 1, 0, 5.43)


participant_1_results <-  esticon(model_1c, participant_1)

participant_1_results

tidy(participant_1_results, conf.int = TRUE)
```


## Joint Hypothesis Testing
```{r}
#| label: 1c-v
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE 
#| tbl-cap: "Joint Hypothesis Testing"
#| tbl-cap-location: top

## Joint Hypothesis Testing
library(car)

joint_hyp_test <- linearHypothesis(
  model_1c,
  c(
    "trtgroupDrug = 0",
    "trtgroupDrug:mutpre = 0"
  )
)

joint_hyp_test

tidy(joint_hyp_test)

kable(tidy(joint_hyp_test))

```

# Treatment effects, part 2

Note to self:

- MS levels \> 5.5 = really bad dental outcomes
- Only interested in 1-month post-baseline
- need to compute odds-ratio of outcome associated with treatment

```{r}
#| label: 2a
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  
#| tbl-cap: "Exponentiated Odds-Ratio of patient MS levels exceeding 5.5(cfu/ml)"
#| tbl-cap-location: top


gum_q2 <- gum_q1 |> 
  mutate(
    mut1mos_threshold = case_when(
      mut1mos > 5.5 ~ 1,
      mut1mos <= 5.5 ~ 0
    )
  )

model_2 <- glm(
  mut1mos_threshold ~ trtgroup,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  data = gum_q2
)

summary(model_2)


model_2 |> 
  tidy(exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) |> 
  kable(digits = 3)

exponentiated_odds_ratio <- exp(model_2$coefficients[2])

odds_percent <- 1 - exponentiated_odds_ratio

odds_percent |> 
  round(digits = 2)
```

Note to self:

- Change to link = "log" to compute the relative risk

## Exponentiated Relative Risk Ratio of patient MS levels exceeding 5.5(cfu/ml)
```{r}
#| label: 2b
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  
#| tbl-cap: "Exponentiated Relative Risk Ratio of patient MS levels exceeding 5.5(cfu/ml)"
#| tbl-cap-location: top


model_2b <- glm(
  mut1mos_threshold ~ trtgroup,
  family = binomial(link = "log"),
  data = gum_q2
)

summary(model_2b)


model_2b |> 
  tidy(exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) |> 
  kable(digits = 3)

model_2b_exponentiated_rr_ratio <- exp(model_2b$coefficients[2])

model_2b_rr_percent <- 1 - model_2b_exponentiated_rr_ratio

model_2b_rr_percent |> 
  round(digits = 2)

```

## Statistical Models

### Gaussian GLM with identity link
```{r}
#| label: tbl-3b-i
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  
#| tbl-cap: "Gaussian GLM with identity link"
#| tbl-cap-location: top

gauss_glm_dmfs <- glm(
  dmfs ~ age,
  family = gaussian(link = "identity"),
  data = gum
)

summary(gauss_glm_dmfs)

gauss_glm_dmfs |> 
  tidy(conf.int = TRUE) |> 
  kable(digits = 3)

```


### Gaussian GLM with identity link and log(dmfs)
```{r}
#| label: tbl-3b-ii
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  
#| tbl-cap: "Gaussian GLM with identity link and log(dmfs)"
#| tbl-cap-location: top

gauss_glm_log_dmfs <- glm(
  log(dmfs) ~ age,
  family = gaussian(link = "identity"),
  data = gum,
  subset = dmfs > 0
)

summary(gauss_glm_log_dmfs )

gauss_glm_log_dmfs |> 
  tidy(conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) |> 
  kable(digits = 3)

```


### Gaussian GLM with log lin
```{r}
#| label: tbl-3b-iii
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  
#| tbl-cap: "Gaussian GLM with log link"
#| tbl-cap-location: top

gauss_glm_link_log_dmfs <- glm(
  dmfs + 0.001 ~ age,
  family = gaussian(link = "log"),
  data = gum
)

summary(gauss_glm_link_log_dmfs )

gauss_glm_link_log_dmfs  |> 
  tidy(conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) |> 
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Exponentiated")

gauss_glm_link_log_dmfs  |> 
  tidy(conf.int = TRUE) |> 
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Untransformed")


```


### Poisson GLM with log link
```{r}
#| label: tbl-3b-iv
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  
#| tbl-cap: "Poisson GLM with log link"
#| tbl-cap-location: top

poisson_glm_link_log_dmfs <- glm(
  dmfs ~ age,
  family = poisson(link = "log"),
  data = gum
)

summary(poisson_glm_link_log_dmfs)

poisson_glm_link_log_dmfs |> 
  tidy(conf.int = TRUE) |> 
  kable(digits = 3)

```


### Combined Model Plots
```{r}
#| label: residuals-df
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  

residuals_df <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(
    model = "Gaussian Identity",
    fitted = fitted(gauss_glm_dmfs),
    residual = rstandard(gauss_glm_dmfs, type = "pearson")
  ),
  data.frame(
    model = "Gaussian Identity + log(DMFS)",
    fitted = fitted(gauss_glm_log_dmfs),
    residual = rstandard(gauss_glm_log_dmfs, type = "pearson")
  ),
  data.frame(
    model = "Gaussian Log Link",
    fitted = fitted(gauss_glm_link_log_dmfs),
    residual = rstandard(gauss_glm_link_log_dmfs, type = "pearson")
  ),
  data.frame(
    model = "Poisson Log Link",
    fitted = fitted(poisson_glm_link_log_dmfs),
    residual = rstandard(poisson_glm_link_log_dmfs, type = "pearson")
  )
)

```


### Pearson Residuals vs Statistical Models
```{r}
#| label: fig-residuals-plot-models
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  
#| fig-cap: "Pearson Residuals vs Statistical Models"
#| fig-cap-location: top

ggplot(residuals_df, aes(x = fitted, y = residual)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ model, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    x = "Fitted values",
    y = "Standardized Pearson residuals"
  )

```
